request: Activate the complete Kalaxy3 SAGE mandatory operating contract. Require current Git, GitHub, SAGE, and runtime authority before mutation; evidence-based selection and reuse of repository-owned components; composition manifests; capability-gap receipts; real runtime validation; failure diagnosis that records what failed, what should have been done, which existing component should have been used, why the actual path differed, and the reusable correction; measurable outcome, reuse, authority, failure, rework, and safety statistics; Git credential and history safety; and an operator-executed, visible, one-boundary-at-a-time Git/GitHub mutation gate. Downloaded implementation helpers may edit and validate repository files but may only inspect Git read-only and may not create or switch branches, stage, commit, push, pull, merge, rebase, reset, clean, delete refs, mutate GitHub, or deploy.

required_capabilities.description: Construct schema 1.0 semantic outcome reports and compatible trends without fabricated measurements or opaque scores.

candidates.rationale: Useful event aggregation, but it lacks the operating-contract semantic metric and trend contract.
Provides the exact schema-driven, least-authority in-memory measurement capability.

selections.selection_basis: Exact raw, derived, null, mutation-separation, and comparable-trend semantics.
